messages:
Elaine (AE): Hi team — Prospect (HelixPay) asked for a single ZIP with: BOM (hardware + instance sizing), per-hour POC cost, security questionnaire answers, and the SOW template. Deadline EOD tomorrow. Can we assemble? :handshake:
Sam (Solutions Eng): FYI they want 95th p50 latency at 8k tokens and embedding throughput 200 req/s for initial eval. Need model variants and quantization plan.
Maria (Solutions): I can draft BOM and perf assumptions. Quick q: are they ok with a burst on Dedicated or do they want strictly isolated capacity?
Elaine (AE): They said "reserved capacity preferred, but can accept burst if documented" — exact quote from the buyer.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Ok. Will run a short perf sweep tomorrow AM. I'll attach a minimal benchmark and a sample run command.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ops-bot, please provision a tiny perf cluster for benchmarks (2x A100s) in us-west-2 for 3 hours.
ops-bot: Provisioning request accepted. Ticket #INC-8421. ETA 12m.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For transparency I'm proposing two BOM options:
- Option A (Dedicated reserve): 4xA100, 16 vCPU control plane, 1TB NVMe, throughput profile + 99.9% SLA.
- Option B (Burst-capable): 2xA100 reserved + autoscale to 8xA100 with burst policy, slightly higher egress estimate.
Maria (Solutions): I'll convert that into a table for the RFI matrix. Also will add token-based cost calc: token assumptions = 8k tokens/session, avg sessions/day 1000, retention cache hit 30%.
Elaine (AE): They also asked for a redacted network diagram and KMS/HSM info. Jordan (Legal), can you provide the latest NDA + SOW redlines we normally share for POCs?
Jordan (Legal): Yes. I'll attach two files: "standard-nda-redline.pdf" and "poc-sow-template-2026.docx". Note: remove the indemnity clause for eval (standard practice).
Sam (Solutions Eng): Attaching small benchmark snippet for their ops team — run locally against our hosted test model to reproduce throughput.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```bash
# simple loadgen for embeddings
python -m locust -f locustfile.py --headless -u 200 -r 20 --run-time 5m
# or curl quick smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-1","input":"test"}'
```
Maria (Solutions): For the security questionnaire, they sent the standard 80-question doc. I've filled the high-risk answers and flagged items for IAM, network isolation, and data residency. Need input on KMS/HSM response lines.
Jordan (Legal): For KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) and offer on-prem HSM options for Private. I'll draft one-liners and attach as "kms-hsm-answer.txt".
Elaine (AE): Great. Can we also include a short tech note on fallback behavior (model routing) if capacity constrained? Customer asked about deterministic fallback.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll add: "Smart routing enforces policy → prefer pinned model → fallback to quantized variant with functional parity; telemetry logs emitted and tracing ID passed for replay." Short bullet in the RFI.
Maria (Solutions): Attaching list of included files for the ZIP: [bom-dedicated-vs-burst.csv, poc-cost-calculator.xlsx, redacted-network-diagram.png, security-answers.pdf, kms-hsm-answer.txt, standard-nda-redline.pdf, poc-sow-template-2026.docx, perf-runbook.md]
Elaine (AE): Perfect. I'll upload ZIP to the Sales Drive and share a signed NDA link. Also prepping an email with the high-level capability matrix.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Quick note — include the micro-benchmark numbers and the exact command used so they can reproduce. Otherwise ops teams question numbers.
Jordan (Legal): NDA uploaded to Drive. Removing indemnity language in section 4 per request.
Elaine (AE): Thanks all. I'll push the draft to the drive by 3pm and ping buyer. If anything urgent DM me. :rocket:
